items.description: A saved Wake on LAN host (Services → Wake on LAN, plugin os-wol). Wake it with the opnsense_wol_wake action.

interface.description: Assigned interface the host is on, e.g. `lan`. It needs a static IPv4 address: the plugin sends to the interface's broadcast address.

mac.description: MAC address, lower case with colons, e.g. `00:11:22:33:44:55`.
validators: stringvalidator.RegexMatches(macAttrRe, "must be a lower-case MAC address with colons, e.g. 00:11:22:33:44:55")

descr.description: Name shown in the UI and the dashboard widget; also used to import.
